# Re-parse TODO songs from the note
note_id=3084
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=token)
content = note['content']

pattern=re.compile(r"^- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (.+)$")
rows=[]
for ln in content.splitlines():
    m=pattern.match(ln.strip())
    if m:
        title=m.group(1).strip()
        artists_raw=m.group(2).strip()
        released_at=m.group(3).strip()
        rows.append({'title':title,'artists_raw':artists_raw,'released_at':released_at,'line':ln})

rows_todo=[r for r in rows if r['released_at'].upper()=='TODO']
print('note_title',note['title'])
print('total_rows',len(rows))
print('todo_rows',len(rows_todo))
print('todo_titles',[(r['title'],r['artists_raw']) for r in rows_todo])

# Login to Spotify using supervisor-stored credentials
sp_password = [a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='la-mcco@gmail.com', password=sp_password)['access_token']
print('spotify_token_prefix',sp_token[:12])

# Fetch all liked songs (paginate)
liked=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=sp_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('liked_page',page_index,'count',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    liked.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break
print('total_liked_songs_fetched',len(liked))

# Helper to normalize artist names

def norm_artists(artists_raw):
    parts=[p.strip() for p in artists_raw.split(',') if p.strip()]
    return sorted([p.lower() for p in parts])

def norm_artists_from_sp(artists_list):
    return sorted([a['name'].strip().lower() for a in artists_list])

# Build matches: for each TODO note entry, find liked songs with same title and same normalized artist set
note_todo_matches={}
for r in rows_todo:
    na=norm_artists(r['artists_raw'])
    matches=[]
    for s in liked:
        if s['title'].strip().lower()==r['title'].strip().lower() and norm_artists_from_sp(s['artists'])==na:
            matches.append({'song_id':s['song_id'], 'album_title':s.get('album_title'), 'liked_at':s.get('liked_at')})
    note_todo_matches[r['title']]=matches

for r in rows_todo:
    matches=note_todo_matches[r['title']]
    print('match',r['title'],'artists',r['artists_raw'],'num',len(matches),'song_ids',[m['song_id'] for m in matches])

def to_month_year(release_date):
    # release_date like '2019-01-01T00:00:00'
    m=re.match(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})", release_date)

    year=m.group(1)
